description: Readability of a text in pure code: Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau and ARI, with counts of characters, words, sentences, syllables and complex words, and reading and speaking time. English formulas; other languages get counts only. Syllables are counted by a vowel-group heuristic, so scores are estimates. Up to 100 KB. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

language.description: en (default: all formulas); other codes return counts and times only
